column3: “Falling … more than you” is rendered “inferior to you.”
“Smearers of falsehood” is rendered “you smear with lies.”
“Lift up his face” is rendered “show partiality.”
“In my palm” is rendered “in my hands.”
The written text reads “I will not hope”; NASB follows the reading aloud, “I will hope in Him.” “There!” is rendered “Though.”
“I am in the right” is rendered “I will be vindicated.”
“Make a mark” is rendered “set a limit”; the meaning is uncertain.
